original_evidence.text: | Arduino IDE (v2) | arduino/arduino-ide | Electron + Theia | Y | check: automatic on launch (`autoDownload = false`); download and install require explicit user action (`downloadUpdate()` then `quitAndInstall()`) | Y — downloads the full installer via `electron-updater` and executes/installs it once the user confirms | HTTPS, `generic` provider at `https://downloads.arduino.cc/arduino-ide` (default; a preference, but ships HTTPS); no `rejectUnauthorized`/insecure overrides found anywhere in the extension | N — electron-updater's generic-provider manifest (`latest.yml`/`latest-mac.yml`/`latest-linux.yml`) is a plain unsigned YAML file fetched over HTTPS, not itself signed | hash-from-manifest (SHA512 in `latest*.yml`) **plus** OS-code-signing: Windows installer is Authenticode-signed (`electron-app/package.json` → `win.sign: "./scripts/windowsCustomSign.js"`, electron-updater's default `verifyUpdateCodeSignature` compares publisher cert) and macOS build is hardened-runtime + notarized (`afterSign: "scripts/notarize.js"`) | OS trust store / code-signing certificate embedded in the installer (Windows Authenticode publisher cert, Apple Developer ID used for notarization) — not an app-specific key | `arduino-ide-extension/src/electron-main/ide-updater/ide-updater-impl.ts:15,42-49,55-98,100-115` (autoUpdater wiring, `autoDownload=false`, `setFeedURL({provider:'generic',...})`, `downloadUpdate`/`quitAndInstall`); `electron-app/package.json:107-203` (win.sign, mac hardenedRuntime+notarize, s3 publish); `arduino-ide-extension/src/browser/arduino-preferences.ts:181` (default base URL) |

fields.label: auto
fields.value: check: automatic on launch (`autoDownload = false`); download and install require explicit user action (`downloadUpdate()` then `quitAndInstall()`)

fields.label: downloads_and_executes
fields.value: Y — downloads the full installer via `electron-updater` and executes/installs it once the user confirms

fields.label: transport
fields.value: HTTPS, `generic` provider at `https://downloads.arduino.cc/arduino-ide` (default; a preference, but ships HTTPS); no `rejectUnauthorized`/insecure overrides found anywhere in the extension

fields.label: manifest_signed
fields.value: N — electron-updater's generic-provider manifest (`latest.yml`/`latest-mac.yml`/`latest-linux.yml`) is a plain unsigned YAML file fetched over HTTPS, not itself signed

fields.label: payload_verification
fields.value: hash-from-manifest (SHA512 in `latest*.yml`) **plus** OS-code-signing: Windows installer is Authenticode-signed (`electron-app/package.json` → `win.sign: "./scripts/windowsCustomSign.js"`, electron-updater's default `verifyUpdateCodeSignature` compares publisher cert) and macOS build is hardened-runtime + notarized (`afterSign: "scripts/notarize.js"`)

fields.label: verifying_key_source
fields.value: OS trust store / code-signing certificate embedded in the installer (Windows Authenticode publisher cert, Apple Developer ID used for notarization) — not an app-specific key

fields.label: evidence
fields.value: `arduino-ide-extension/src/electron-main/ide-updater/ide-updater-impl.ts:15,42-49,55-98,100-115` (autoUpdater wiring, `autoDownload=false`, `setFeedURL({provider:'generic',...})`, `downloadUpdate`/`quitAndInstall`); `electron-app/package.json:107-203` (win.sign, mac hardenedRuntime+notarize, s3 publish); `arduino-ide-extension/src/browser/arduino-preferences.ts:181` (default base URL)
